endpoint.recipe: ai/client.go fixed /aig/v1 with exact override support
endpoint.scope: caller-asserted account; no project or location inferred

request.mapping: explicit model/protected prompt/positive Integer n/response_format url or b64_json; no URL fetch
excluded_variants: image options/edits/variations/streaming beyond selected compatible generation wire
Whole provider inventory and deployment-specific availability remain unverified

response.completeness: bounded structured response; embedding/image count mismatch returns incomplete with accepted receipt and typed prefix; no resource/task/ref adoption
response.usage: exact typed counters, discriminated transcription duration/tokens, no absent-as-zero or billing/readiness inference
response.refs: completion/model IDs remain protected metadata; no resource/task ref or wait

errors.mapping: core HTTP mapping; raw messages/body discarded; accepted malformed/body-limit error retains Receipt
errors.guardrail: 422 nested guardrail_rejected, compiled code only, JSON before any streaming

retry: all model POST mutations: no automatic replay, no idempotency assumptions
